rationale: The memory_capture unit adds one new top-level config key, memory_capture (explicit|experimental-auto, default explicit), following the exact pattern of memory_watcher_model/memory_embed_model/run_intent: applyDefaults resolves it, sparseForSave omits the default, ConfigValue/ApplyConfigChange/ConfigKeysHelp wire get/set/unset. There is no third (review/staging) mode.

U2 (delete-ts-cli) deletes the promotable RPC method end to end: /learnings, `pix memory learnings`, and the frequency-ranked promotable surface had no remaining in-tree consumer once both were removed, so the JSON-RPC method table drops "promotable" along with them. (`synthesize` is itself deleted outright by the later U9 pass, so it no longer belongs in this entry's `to` either — see memory.rpc.methods.server's current `expected` set, which this now matches exactly.)
extensions/memory-recall.ts's /learnings command was the only client caller of the "promotable" RPC method; deleting the command (see memory.rpc.methods.server) removes the call too.
